_comment: Labelled crew messages for the field-note extraction audit.
Each entry carries what a COMPETENT HUMAN would read out of the message, not what the
model currently returns. Scoring against model output would make the corpus agree with
`expect.event_type` is null where the message is not a practice record at all, and
'ambiguous' where it is more than one record. Both are correct answers, not failures.
Run with: manage.py audit_crew_messages. It is NOT in CI: it spends OpenAI calls.
`expect.event_type` uses ONLY the prompt's own vocabulary. A label the model is never offered scores a label error as a model error.

Entries with `kind: "voice"` carry `spoken` (synthesised with macOS `say`, sent as OGG/Opus over a local TLS media host so the REAL fetch_media and Deepgram run) and `text` (what a competent listener would write). `must_hear` names the words whose loss changes the record.

entries.text: Regamos River Block esta mañana, dos horas con el goteo
entries.why: The post's own example. Block named in English inside a Spanish sentence, which is how crews actually talk.

entries.text: Terminé de fertilizar el bloque 2 con 200 libras de urea
Pode el bloque norte hoy, como 4 horas
corte el piso entre lineas en el bloque 4
entries.why: No accents, no capitals. This is what a phone keyboard in a field produces.

entries.text: Aplicamos azufre en el bloque 3, 40 galones
Cosechamos el bloque 1, 85 bines
Pusimos las colmenas en el bloque de almendras, 20 colmenas
Llevé la carga a la descascaradora, 12 toneladas
entries.why: No block at all. The confirmer must still pick one; the parse must not invent it.

entries.text: Prendimos las maquinas de viento anoche por la helada, 5 horas
entries.why: 'anoche' is a real day reference and it is NOT today.

entries.text: Rastreamos el bloque 5 con el tractor, dos pasadas
Raleamos el bloque de duraznos, terminamos como a mediodia
entries.why: 'a mediodia' is a time of day, not a date. It must not become a date.

entries.text: Sembramos el cover crop en las entrelineas del bloque 6
Limpiamos el tanque de la aspersora antes de empezar

expect.label_note: Was `equipment`, which is NOT in the prompt's enumerated vocabulary: the prompt directs tractor and machinery work to `cultivation`. Corrected after the review of back #185 found these five could never score right.

entries.why: Equipment cleaning is a 112.140 record and crews report it casually.

entries.text: Aplique compost en el bloque 2, como 3 toneladas por acre
Regamos por aspersión el bloque 7 toda la tarde
No apliqué nada en el bloque 4, estaba muy ventoso
entries.why: THE dangerous one. If 'nada' is dropped this becomes an application that never happened.

entries.text: Hoy no regamos, el suelo todavia esta humedo
No pudimos entrar al bloque 3, el camino esta muy mojado
Cancelamos la aplicación de azufre por el viento
entries.why: Negation carried by a verb ('cancelamos') rather than by 'no'.

entries.text: Regamos el bloque 2 pero no el bloque 3
entries.why: MIXED negation: one block done, one not. Must go to manual review, never auto-resolve.

entries.text: Aplicamos cal al bloque 8
entries.why: No day anywhere. The backdated-glyphosate class: a guessed date prints into a certifier packet.

entries.text: Terminamos la poda del bloque viejo
Se aplicó aceite mineral en los cerezos
El martes regamos el bloque 5, se me olvidó avisar
entries.why: Reported late, on purpose. 'el martes' is the record's day, not the message's day.

entries.text: Ayer aplicamos el fertilizante en el bloque 1
La semana pasada podamos el bloque de peras
entries.why: 'la semana pasada' is a RANGE, not a day. It cannot become a specific date by itself.

entries.text: El 14 aplicamos sulfato de zinc en el bloque 2
entries.why: A day number with no month. Ambiguous across month boundaries.

entries.text: Irrigated the River Block this morning, 2 hours on drip
entries.why: English twin of es-001. Same facts, so a language difference in the parse shows up here.

entries.text: Sprayed sulfur on block 4, 40 gallons
Finished pruning the north block, about 6 hours with the crew
Mowed the orchard floor in block 6
Hauled 14 tons of walnuts to the huller
Put 24 hives in the almond block today
Ran the wind machines last night, about 5 hours
Picked block 2 yesterday, 92 bins off it
Disced the middles in block 5, two passes with the tractor
Washed out the sprayer tank before we started

expect.label_note: Was `equipment`, which is NOT in the prompt's enumerated vocabulary: the prompt directs tractor and machinery work to `cultivation`. Corrected after the review of back #185 found these five could never score right.

entries.text: Thinned the cherry block, finished around noon
Spread compost on the home ranch, 3 tons per acre
Applied 2.5 lb per acre of copper on block 3
entries.why: A RATE, not a total. Reading it as a total overstates by the block's acreage.

entries.text: Put down 400 pounds of gypsum total on block 7
entries.why: A TOTAL, said explicitly. The twin of the rate above.

entries.text: Irrigated block 1, about 4 acre-inches
Aplicamos 3 kilos por hectárea de azufre en el bloque 9
entries.why: Metric rate from a Spanish speaker on a US farm. Both unit systems in one corpus on purpose.

entries.text: Sprayed 100 gal of water with 2 qt of oil on block 8
entries.why: TWO quantities with different units. Picking the wrong one as 'the' quantity is the failure.

entries.text: Regamos el bloque 2 y despues podamos el bloque 3
entries.why: Two activities, two blocks. One record cannot hold both; merging loses one of them.

entries.text: Mowed block 4 and sprayed sulfur on block 5 after lunch
Fertilizamos y regamos el bloque 6 el mismo dia
entries.why: Two activities, ONE block. Still two records.

entries.text: Irrigated the Sunset Block this morning
entries.why: No such block on the seeded farm. Must surface as the crew's words, never resolve to a real parcel.

entries.text: Aplicamos azufre en el bloque 42
Sprayed the block next to the Hernandez place
entries.why: A block named by a landmark, which is how crews actually refer to ground. Unresolvable by design.

entries.text: Sprayed Roundup along the fence line on block 3
entries.why: Glyphosate on a certified organic operation. The parse may record it; what must NOT happen is it printing as routine practice with no flag.

entries.text: Aplicamos urea sintética en el bloque 2
entries.why: Synthetic nitrogen, 205.602. Note es-002 says plain 'urea', which is the ambiguous twin.

entries.text: Used the neighbor's copper, not sure if it is OMRI listed
entries.why: UNKNOWN is not PROHIBITED and must not be rendered as either. Unknown stays unknown.

entries.text: El vecino fumigó y nos llegó deriva al bloque 1
entries.why: DRIFT, not an application. 205.400(f)(1) is a duty to notify, never permission. It is also not the farm's own practice.

entries.text: Miguel regó el bloque 4 esta mañana
entries.why: show_full_performer_names has no writer, so the consent it represents cannot be collected, so the name must not be.

entries.text: Jose and Carlos finished pruning block 7
Le dije a Don Ramon que regara el bloque 5 pero lo hice yo
entries.why: Two people named, neither of them the performer. Even a correct attribution guess is the wrong behaviour.

entries.text: ok gracias
entries.why: Must refuse. Fabricating an activity from an acknowledgement is the worst possible output.

entries.text: Buenos dias jefe, puedo salir temprano hoy? tengo cita con el doctor
entries.why: Personal and private. It must not become a record, and it should not be quoted onto a buyer page.

entries.text: The truck has a flat, we are stuck at the gate
entries.why: Operationally real, not a practice record.
An emoji alone. Crews send these constantly.

entries.text: Se me hizo tarde, llego en 20 minutos
regams el bloq 2 hoy x la mañana komo 2 hrs
entries.why: Typos and SMS shorthand. A crew member typing fast with gloves on.

entries.text: BLOQUE 3 LISTO
entries.why: All caps and no verb. 'Done' with no activity named is unparseable and must not be guessed.

entries.text:
regamos el bloque 4
luego fertilizamos
como 200 lb
termine 3pm
entries.why: Multi-line, the way a crew sends a running list. Also multi-task.

entries.text: Perdon, el mensaje anterior era del bloque 5 no del 4
entries.why: A CORRECTION to an earlier message. There is no thread model, so this cannot amend anything and must not become its own record.

entries.text: same as yesterday
entries.why: Depends entirely on a previous message. Resolving it would be inventing content.

entries.text: Regamos el bloque 2, 2 horas. Ah y tambien limpiamos la aspersora
entries.why: An afterthought tacked on, which is how a second task usually arrives.

entries.text: Irrigamos o bloco 2 hoje de manhã, duas horas
entries.why: Portuguese. The parser serves pt, but the roster language is declared per sender, so a mismatch is the real test.

entries.text: ਅਸੀਂ ਬਲਾਕ 3 ਨੂੰ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਿੱਤਾ
entries.why: Punjabi, a real California farmworker language the parser does NOT serve. It must refuse, not parse as English. This is the one the landing copy is careful about.

entries.text: Aplicamos bioestimulante foliar en el bloque 1
Revisamos las trampas de plaga en el bloque 4, habia poca actividad
entries.why: Scouting, not an application. The distinction matters for the carbon card and for the packet.

entries.text: Cambiamos los goteros tapados del bloque 7

expect.label_note: Was `equipment`, which is NOT in the prompt's enumerated vocabulary: the prompt directs tractor and machinery work to `cultivation`. Corrected after the review of back #185 found these five could never score right.

entries.text: Terminamos de cosechar, 140 bines en total del bloque 3
Pusimos trampas de feromona en el bloque de nogales
Regamos el bloque 8 anoche, cuatro horas
Aplicamos harina de pluma al bloque 5
entries.why: Feather meal. A real OMRI-listed input whose NPK the catalogue has been wrong about before.

entries.text: Desbrozamos las orillas del bloque 6
Sacamos las colmenas del bloque de almendras hoy
entries.why: Hives OUT, not in. The reverse of es-007 and the same event type.

entries.text: Injertamos 40 arboles en el bloque nuevo
Checked the pheromone traps in block 6, low counts
Flushed the drip lines on block 7 this afternoon

expect.label_note: Was `equipment`, which is NOT in the prompt's enumerated vocabulary: the prompt directs tractor and machinery work to `cultivation`. Corrected after the review of back #185 found these five could never score right.

entries.text: Applied fish emulsion to the young trees in block 9
Hand weeded around the new plantings in block 10
entries.why: Hand weeding is weed control with NO input. A parse that invents a herbicide here is a serious error.

entries.text: Shook block 1 and swept the windrows
entries.why: Walnut harvest vocabulary. 'Shook' is the operation.

entries.text: Delivered 8 bins to the packer this morning
Replaced the filter on the irrigation pump

expect.label_note: Was `equipment`, which is NOT in the prompt's enumerated vocabulary: the prompt directs tractor and machinery work to `cultivation`. Corrected after the review of back #185 found these five could never score right.

entries.text: Took soil samples from block 2 and block 3
entries.why: ONE activity across TWO blocks, unlike the multi_task entries which are two activities.

entries.text: Pruned the young block, took out the lower scaffolds
Ran the frost fans from 3am until sunrise
entries.why: A time RANGE with no day. 3am of which night is genuinely ambiguous.

entries.text: Aplicamos doscientas libras de compost en el bloque 2
entries.why: Spelled-out Spanish numeral. The reason smart_format was replaced with numerals=true.

entries.text: Put on about two and a half tons of compost
Regamos como hora y media el bloque 4
Regamos el bloque 2 esta mañana, dos horas
entries.why: Sent TWICE with the same provider message id. Exactly one note must exist.

entries.text: Regamos el bloque 2 esta mañana, dos horas
entries.why: The SAME WORDS under a NEW id, which is a crew member re-sending because they saw no reply. Two notes is correct here, and the inbox must make that legible.

entries.text: Buenos dias, ayer terminamos de regar el bloque 2 como a las 6 de la tarde, estuvimos como tres horas con el goteo porque el suelo estaba muy seco, despues revisamos los filtros y uno estaba tapado asi que lo limpiamos, y hoy en la mañana empezamos con el bloque 3 pero solo alcanzamos media hora porque se fue la luz
entries.why: A long end-of-day report covering two days, three activities and two blocks. The realistic worst case.

entries.text: Regamos el bloque 2. Mi numero nuevo es 530 555 0147 por si acaso
entries.why: A phone number inside a work message. It must never reach the anonymous buyer page through observation.

entries.text: Aplicamos azufre en el bloque 3, me corte la mano pero ya estoy bien
entries.why: An injury disclosure. Health information, and it must not be published or quoted as farmer words.

entries.text: Irrigated block 4. Also my check was short this week
entries.why: A pay dispute riding along with a work report. Same rule.

entries.text: STOP
entries.why: The opt-out keyword. Must deactivate the roster row, acknowledge once, and create no note.

entries.text: Trasplantamos 60 arbolitos al bloque nuevo
entries.why: `transplanting` was absent from the corpus entirely, and the prompt lists it separately from `planting`.

entries.text: Transplanted the replants into block 5 this week
Empezamos a descascarar la nuez de ayer, como 8 toneladas
entries.why: `post_harvest` was absent. Hulling is the walnut operation the prompt names for it.

entries.text: Washed and sorted yesterday's bins at the barn
Arreglamos la cerca del lado norte
entries.why: `general` was absent as an EXPECTATION. Real farm work that fits no specific category is the honest case for it, as opposed to the model falling back to it for noise.

entries.text: Fixed the gate latch on the north side
Aplicamos herbicida orgánico en las orillas del bloque 7
Spot sprayed weeds along the headland of block 2
Plantamos 300 arboles nuevos en el bloque 11
Thinned the green fruit on block 3, two crews all day
Regamos el bloque 4 por goteo, tres horas
entries.why: NOT an application record, so the offer MAY fill. `isApplicationRecord` covers CHEMICAL, SOIL with PA/OM and PEST with BR; irrigation is none of those. The UI walk only ever tested the withholding path.

entries.text: Mowed the orchard floor on block 6, about 3 acres
Podamos el bloque 2, cuatro horas con la cuadrilla
Cosechamos 120 bines del bloque 1
Usamos 12 galones de diesel en el tractor en el bloque 5
entries.why: Fuel feeds the carbon calculation, so a wrong number here is a wrong public figure, not just a wrong form.

entries.spoken: Regamos el bloque cuatro esta mañana, como dos horas con el goteo
entries.text: regamos el bloque 4 esta mañana como 2 horas con el goteo
entries.why: The baseline. If this one does not survive the round trip nothing else is worth reading.

entries.spoken: No apliqué nada en el bloque cuatro, estaba muy ventoso
entries.text: no apliqué nada en el bloque 4 estaba muy ventoso
entries.why: THE REASON VOICE IS TESTED AT ALL. A dropped 'nada' inverts a compliance record, and the speaker is not the person reviewing it, so nobody in the loop can notice. `must_hear` fails the run if either word is lost.

entries.spoken: Hoy no regamos, el suelo todavía está húmedo
entries.text: hoy no regamos el suelo todavía está húmedo

entries.spoken: Apliqué doscientas libras de urea en el bloque dos
entries.text: apliqué 200 libras de urea en el bloque 2
entries.why: Spelled-out numerals through ASR, which is what `numerals=true` replaced smart_format for. A quantity that arrives as words cannot be read as a number.

entries.spoken: Sprayed sulfur on block four this morning, forty gallons
entries.text: sprayed sulfur on block 4 this morning 40 gallons
entries.why: English, so a language-detection failure shows up as a wrong prompt rather than as nothing.

entries.spoken: Regamos el bloque dos y después podamos el bloque tres
entries.text: regamos el bloque 2 y después podamos el bloque 3
entries.why: Two jobs spoken. The caution has to fire on a TRANSCRIPT as well as on typed text.

entries.spoken: Cosechamos ciento veinte bines del bloque uno
entries.text: cosechamos 120 bines del bloque 1
entries.why: MEASURED 2026-10-19: Deepgram returned 'cosechamos 120 del bloque 1' and dropped 'bines'. A quantity without its unit is 120 of nothing, and the first version of this entry only required '120', so the loss passed. The unit is now required: a number that survives without its unit is not a surviving number.

entries.spoken: Miguel regó el bloque cuatro esta mañana
entries.text: miguel regó el bloque 4 esta mañana
entries.why: A name spoken aloud still must not reach a field.

entries.spoken: Buenos días jefe, voy llegando tarde
entries.text: buenos días jefe voy llegando tarde

entries.spoken: ブロック3に水をやりました
entries.text: (Japanese: we watered block 3)
entries.why: A language the parser does not serve, spoken. `detect_language` should report it and the note should be refused rather than parsed against the English prompt. Japanese because macOS ships a voice for it and Punjabi has none.
